display_long_description:
RealityGuard is **a mixed-reality tower defense game** augmented by your physical surrounding environment. Join forces **with your friends** to **build terrain** with real objects around you, **set up defenses**, **cast spells**, and work together to **ward off enemy invasions**.

[media]

- **Real-World Battlefield:** Strategically arrange the furniture in your room to create a customized battlefield in reality.

[media]
- **Local Co-op:** Defend the world together with friends in the same space.

[media]
- **Upgrade & Abilities:** Collect defense towers and unlock unique upgrade paths with special skills.  

--

**RealityGuard** also offers many surprising experiences, including:  
- Legendary story of heroes and experience unique weather, traps, and level events.
- Utilize periodic combat bonuses in endless mode, build the ultimate formation, climb the global rankings, and pursue lucrative rewards.
- Casting a variety of spells to engage directly in combat like a mage to master in your own space.

--

**Learn More**  
Follow our official channels for the latest updates:
- Website: https://www.realityguardar.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@RealityGuard_Official
- Discord Community: https://discord.com/invite/jNmnz9PdVW
